# Zipcator import-contract fixtures ("zipcator-export v1")

These files back the importer tests for the contract in `docs/SPEC.md` §5.3. Keep them tiny.

**Zipcator commit:** `6d9ad8a` (`docs: final QA report ...`), repo `project-zipcator`, clean tree.
Zipcator's `data/` was already built; the commands use coordinates, so no geocoding call is made.

## Real exports (produced by Zipcator's real CLI, unmodified)

Run from the Zipcator folder (`C:\dev\project-zipcator`); output paths are in this folder:

```powershell
uv run zipcator "27.9506, -82.4572" --radius 5 --csv <this folder>\tampa_5mi.csv
uv run zipcator "27.9506, -82.4572" --radius 5 --csv <this folder>\tampa_5mi_excel.csv --excel
uv run zipcator "42.3588, -71.0578" --radius 3 --csv <this folder>\boston_3mi.csv
uv run zipcator "42.3588, -71.0578" --radius 3 --csv <this folder>\boston_3mi_excel.csv --excel
```

| file | shape |
|---|---|
| `tampa_5mi.csv` | plain: no BOM, CRLF, quoted text, ZIP `"33602"`; 12 ZIPs; no population columns |
| `tampa_5mi_excel.csv` | Excel-safe: UTF-8 BOM, ZIP cell `="33602"` (raw bytes `"=""33602"""`); 12 ZIPs |
| `boston_3mi.csv` | plain; 33 ZIPs, all with a leading zero |
| `boston_3mi_excel.csv` | Excel-safe; 33 ZIPs |

Zipcator's current build has no population data, so these lack `Population` and
`Est. pop in radius`.

## Synthetic with-population export (real exporter, made-up data)

`synthetic_population.csv` and `synthetic_population_excel.csv` come from Zipcator's own
`zipcator.export.csv_bytes` run on a **synthetic** result (made-up geometry and populations; the
ZIPs `02108`, `00501`, `33602`; an accented, comma-and-quote city). Generated by
`make_population_fixture.py` (run it from the Zipcator folder; it writes only here).

## Simulated Excel re-saves (NOT produced by Excel)

`make_variants.py` (stdlib only, deterministic) derives these from the real exports to model what
Excel does when a user opens and re-saves a file. They are our best model, not Excel's actual
bytes; if the owner supplies a real re-save, add it here and say so.

| file | models |
|---|---|
| `boston_3mi_resave_zeros_stripped.csv` | plain export saved as "CSV (Comma delimited)": cp1252, no BOM, quotes dropped, ZIPs `2108`, numbers in General format (`100`) |
| `boston_3mi_resave_utf8_bom.csv` | same, saved as "CSV UTF-8": BOM, zeros lost |
| `boston_3mi_excel_resave_plain_zips.csv` | the Excel-safe file re-saved: `="02108"` became text `02108`, cp1252 |
| `boston_3mi_snake_case.csv` | forward-compatibility headers `zip`, `overlap_pct`, ... (SPEC §5.3) |
| `tampa_5mi_semicolon.csv` | semicolon-delimited cp1252 re-save |
| `synthetic_population_resave_cp1252.csv` | with-population shape, cp1252 (accent `ü`), zeros stripped |

## Regenerating

```powershell
uv run python tests/fixtures/zipcator/make_variants.py   # simulated re-saves, from this repo
```

The real exports and the synthetic population files are regenerated only if Zipcator's export
format changes on purpose, which needs a coordinated change in both repos (SPEC §5.3).
